children: EVI Industries reported record fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $446.6 million and gross profit of $140.7 million, while operating income rose to $15.7 million. Net income for the year was $7.7 million and adjusted EBITDA reached a record $29.1 million. The company also completed two commercial laundry acquisitions during the year and launched a consumer garment care division with the acquisition of Sudsies.
Revenue: $446.6 million for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026 (up 15% year-over-year).
Gross profit: $140.7 million for fiscal 2026; gross margin reported at 31.5% (record).
Operating income: $15.7 million for fiscal 2026 (record), compared with $13.8 million prior year.
Net income: $7.7 million for fiscal 2026; fourth-quarter net income $2.7 million (up 31% year-over-year for the quarter).
Adjusted EBITDA: $29.1 million for fiscal 2026 (record); adjusted EBITDA for the fourth quarter $9.1 million.
Completed two acquisitions during fiscal 2026—ASN Laundry Group (Aug 2025) and Belenky, Inc. (Feb 2026)—bringing the commercial laundry platform to 32 businesses.
Launched a new consumer garment care division and closed the foundational acquisition of Sudsies on September 1, 2026 to serve consumers and luxury retail partners.
Recorded operational scale in field service with approximately 30,300 service visits in the fourth quarter, including visits to about 11,600 unique customers.
Progressing enterprise modernization: core ERP, field service, and supporting technology substantially deployed and being used to standardize processes and improve productivity.
Maintained balance sheet flexibility with operating cash flow of $20.6 million for fiscal 2026 and net debt of $44.2 million at June 30, 2026.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: EVI Industries Reports Record FY26 Revenue $446.6M, Gross Profit $140.7M, Operating Income $15.7M
